'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Bucha]]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] calls for [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] to face trials for [[War crimes in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|war crimes]] after more images emerge of the [[Bucha massacre]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2022/04/04/politics/joe-biden-bucha-russia-war-crimes/index.html (CNN)]
***[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that peace talks will continue despite the [[Bucha massacre]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60987350.amp (BBC News)]
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**An [[India]]n [[Central Reserve Police Force]] officer is killed and another is wounded by [[militant]]s in the [[Maisuma]] neighbourhood of [[Srinagar]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/crpf-jawan-killed-another-injured-in-militant-attack-in-srinagar/articleshow/90642689.cms (''Times of India'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Lithuania]] bans Russian [[information technology|IT]] companies from relocating to Lithuania. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/1662234/lithuania-says-no-to-it-firms-relocating-from-russia (LRT)]
**[[Germany]] assumes control of Gazprom Germania, [[Gazprom]]'s German subsidiary, after the German economy ministry declines to approve the subsidiary's acquisition by two entities with unclear beneficiaries. [https://www.ft.com/content/85d0d9b2-ae8a-4889-9133-96d628ad25e5 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[Lebanese liquidity crisis]]
**[[Deputy Prime Minister of Lebanon|Deputy PM]] [[Saadeh Al Shami]] says that [[Lebanon]] and its [[Banque du Liban|central bank]] are [[Bankruptcy|bankrupt]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/lebanon-goes-bankrupt-deputy-prime-minister/2554688 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A train [[derailment|derails]] in [[Lualaba Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], killing seven people and injuring 14 others. [https://punchng.com/train-derails-in-dr-congo-kills-seven/ (''The Punch'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lithuania]]
****[[Lithuania]] lifts requirements for masks in indoor spaces, except in public transport and medical facilities, and reduces the [[COVID-19]] [[Isolation (health care)|isolation]] period to five days. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/1662234/lithuania-says-no-to-it-firms-relocating-from-russia (LRT)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Sweden]]
****The [[Public Health Agency of Sweden]] recommends a fourth [[COVID-19 vaccine]] dose for people over age of 65 years, as well as other adults aged 18–64 with weak immune response. [https://www.thelocal.se/20220404/sweden-offers-fourth-dose-of-covid-19-vaccine-to-over-65s/ (''The Local Sweden'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[China]] reports  13,146 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since the height of the pandemic in [[Wuhan]] in February 2020. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220403-china-reports-13-000-covid-cases-most-since-end-of-wuhan-s-first-wave (France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Lithuania–Russia relations]]
***[[Lithuania]] orders the closure of the Russian consulate in [[Klaipėda]] and downgrades diplomatic ties with Russia, ordering the Russian [[ambassador]] to leave the country. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/1662330/lithuania-expels-russian-ambassador-downgrades-diplomatic-ties (LRT)]
**[[France–Russia relations]], [[Germany–Russia relations]], [[Latvia–Russia relations]]
***[[France]], [[Germany]] and [[Latvia]] expel [[Russia]]n [[diplomat]]s in response to [[war crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]], specifically the [[Bucha massacre]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/lithuania-latvia-germany-diplomats-bucha/31785565.html (Radio Free Europe)] [https://www.axios.com/germany-russia-diplomat-expel-bucha-ae543d8f-c241-4e7c-b944-5651b8d5f820.html (''Axios'')]
**[[Russia–European Union relations]], [[Iceland–Russia relations]], [[Norway–Russia relations]], [[Russia–Switzerland relations]]
***[[Russia]] restricts diplomats, journalists, and politicians from the [[European Union]], [[Iceland]], [[Norway]], [[Switzerland]], and [[Liechtenstein]] from obtaining a [[Travel visa|visa]] by a simplified procedure. [https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/5293477 (''Kommersant'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-imposes-visa-restrictions-citizens-unfriendly-countries-2022-04-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Sacramento shooting]]
**The [[Sacramento Police Department]] arrests a 26-year-old man in connection to yesterday's [[mass shooting]] that left six people dead and 12 others injured. [https://www.ktvu.com/news/suspect-arrested-in-connection-to-sacramento-mass-shooting-police-say (KTVU-TV)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Astronomers announce the discovery of [[K2-2016-BLG-0005Lb]], an [[exoplanet]] that is said to resemble [[Jupiter]]. The discovery was made using the now-retired [[Kepler space telescope]]. [https://www.sciencealert.com/kepler-s-data-most-distant-planet-detection-is-a-jupiter-twin-17-000-light-years-away?msclkid=9d5c2e1cb43e11ec9305b23f6ddd85d6 (ScienceAlert)]
*The third part of the [[IPCC Sixth Assessment Report]] is released, studying methods to mitigate climate change. [https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/about-us/press-office/news/weather-and-climate/2022/met-office-response-to-ipcc-working-group-iii-report (Met Office)]
*[[Centerra Gold]] announces that they have reached an agreement with [[Kyrgyzstan]] to hand control of the [[Kumtor Gold Mine]] to the [[Government of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz government]]. [https://www.mining.com/centerra-gold-hands-kumtor-mine-to-kyrgyzstan-ending-dispute/ (Mining.com)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[2021–22 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas Jayhawks]] rally from a 15-point deficit to defeat the 8th-seeded [[2021–22 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina Tar Heels]] 72–69 in the [[2022 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Game|National Championship Game]]. This is the 4th championship for the [[Kansas Jayhawks]] [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|men's basketball team]], and their first [[2007–08 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|since 2008]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/04/04/sports/unc-kansas-score (''The New York Times'')]
